models.rf: common.make_model('RF'): RandomForestRegressor(300 trees, min_samples_leaf=2), n_jobs=1 (1 for bit-exact cross-process reproducibility)
models.hgb_fused_drop: training rows with >=1 auxiliary duplicated with all auxiliaries NaN

splits.lab: whole laboratory-composition units: test>=20%, cal>=25% of rest, rng=default_rng(1000+seed)

CTEbelowTg.verdict: used (dilatometry; the same run can also give a dilatometric Tg)

YoungModulus.verdict: not used (4th modality makes patterns sparse)

T12.verdict: excluded (Tg ~ 10^12 Pa s temperature, near-label leakage)

PoissonRatio.verdict: excluded (usually derived from E and G)

Microhardness.verdict: not used (not in the A2 design)
